question: Should `agents.run`, `phase`, and `log` become the supported long-term QuickJS Code Mode orchestration contract under the existing experimental Swarm gate?
rationale: The branch adds a new guest-visible API and persisted restart-replay semantics; tests can validate an approved design but cannot choose its permanent public contract or support boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Accept the three globals as the experimental Swarm API, contingent on restart-resume proof and a refreshed review against current main.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Ask for a smaller internal seam or a reduced guest API before committing to public QuickJS orchestration semantics.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Keep Swarm core without exposing QuickJS orchestration until a maintainer-owned API and documentation plan is agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Accept the three globals as the experimental Swarm API, contingent on restart-resume proof and a refreshed review against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The related Swarm proposal and the current implementation both originate from this contributor, making them the closest available routing point for the proposed contract.
